MappingDocumentController - held state and command boundary
|
|-- context: CanvasEditingContext handle
|   `-- -> shared CanvasHistoryService (owns the archive, not this controller)
|-- snapshot: ControllerSnapshot -> [state]
|-- pendingNodeIds / nodeCache / listeners / layout / viewCamera
|-- editorDriver?: attached reference (mounted runtime owns its lifetime)
|   `-- attachEditorDriver(): at most one; detach callback clears reference
|
`-- Command facade
    |-- applyUpdate(expectedVersion, operations); transact delegates here
    |   |-- -> editorDriver.settle() before checking version
    |   |-- Clear pending node correspondence; stage applyOperations()
    |   |   |-- Reject stale version; clone document + canvas
    |   |   |-- Apply edits, revisions, layout, edges, alternatives and reviews
    |   |   `-- -> stored revision APIs for exact immutable diagram revisions
    |   `-- -> updateSnapshot(record=true); return version + derived nodes
    |-- commitEditorGesture(operations, canvas)
    |   `-- Stage native moves and pane geometry as one semantic checkpoint
    |-- updateSnapshot(next, record, increment)
    |   |-- Reconcile links on recorded scene edits; validate changed document links
    |   |-- Normalize views/selection; resolve floating geometry
    |   |-- If recording -> history.append(context, document, canvas, node IDs)
    |   |-- Resolve contents to registered revisions; replace current snapshot
    |   `-- Notify subscribers -> session stores and mounted editor runtime
    |-- updateCanvas(value, record=false)
    |   |-- Default: transient publication; no history append or version increment
    |   `-- record=true: settle driver and record (select() uses this path)
    |-- commitDocument / commitProjectionLayout
    |   `-- Settle driver, validate projection, record via updateSnapshot
    |-- undo(redo=false)
    |   |-- Mounted: -> editorDriver.undo(redo)
    |   `-- Headless: -> history.navigate(); restore without appending
    |-- restoreEditorCheckpoint(checkpointId)
    |   `-- Navigate archive to native checkpoint; publish without appending
    |-- persistenceChanges(cursor)
    |   `-- -> history.persistenceChanges(context, cursor) -> adapter [archive]
    `-- Transfer / fork / canvasView commands
        `-- -> shared history service; linked transfers require workspace undo
